cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(CDesign LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

# Chinese output on Chinese Windows: source is UTF-8, console is GBK(936).
# Without this, cout << "..." shows garbage.
if(MINGW)
    add_compile_options(-fexec-charset=GBK)
endif()

# Every .cpp in src/ becomes its own program with the same name.
# NAME_WLE strips ONLY ".cpp", so lab1.1.cpp -> program name "lab1.1".
# DO NOT edit this file. DO NOT use the "Add to target" checkbox in CLion.
file(GLOB SOURCES "src/*.cpp")
foreach(src ${SOURCES})
    get_filename_component(name ${src} NAME_WLE)
    # target name: dots are legal in CMake targets, but keep it simple anyway
    string(REPLACE "." "_" tgt "${name}")
    add_executable(${tgt} ${src})
    set_target_properties(${tgt} PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME "${name}")
endforeach()
